componentProps.text: ERPNext is a free and open source ERP covering accounting, inventory, manufacturing, CRM, HR, and more — with no per-user licensing costs and full control over your data.
Why do I need an implementation partner?
A certified partner brings hands-on experience configuring ERPNext for your industry, migrating existing data safely, training your team, and providing ongoing support after go-live.
How long does a typical implementation take?
Timelines vary by scope — a focused single-module rollout can take a few weeks, while a full ERP replacement across multiple sites typically takes a few months.
